capabilities: publish the current note as a new JoySpace page and bind it via note properties
update the bound JoySpace page in place, skipping when content is unchanged
publish a note together with its one-level references, converting wiki links to JoySpace links
configure the default or per-note publish location in YAML properties
import a JoySpace document link as a new Markdown file
disambiguation: Publishes only to JoySpace pages, not to a personal website or blog.
extras: README is in Chinese; setup is non-trivial (Python, browser_cookie3, Node.js WebCLI, browser login state), and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wrote notes in Obsidian and wanted one-click publishing to JoySpace so colleagues could read them online.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share local notes as JoySpace pages or pull JoySpace documents back into the vault.

requires.name: JoySpace login in a supported browser

summary: Publishes, updates, and imports Markdown notes between Obsidian and JoySpace, with page binding stored in note properties.
